about: Hand it to Hush eval (ADR-019): snippets people copy, reworked by the on-device model. Checks: shorter is at most 75% as long, bullets are '- ' lines, simpler isn't longer than 120%, and every number survives. Run: swift run hush-eval --lane pouch

Hi team, just wanted to give everyone a quick update on where we are with the launch. We've finished the onboarding flow and the pricing page, and design signed off on both yesterday. The remaining work is the email sequence and the analytics events, which Dana and Sam are picking up this week. If all goes to plan we'll be ready for the beta on the 28th. Let me know if you have any questions or concerns!
